name: ecom Tab-Ex 04 Pro DZ2
statusNote: ecom lists it as discontinued and names no 10-inch successor.
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 04 Pro DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 10.1-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 15. It has been discontinued.
imageAlt: ecom Tab-Ex 04 Pro DZ2, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current (issue 1), checked 2026-10-25. Product moved to the archive; ecom's release plan still lists it.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T5 Gc / Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: SGS: Class I, Division 2, Groups A,B,C,D T5; Class II, Division 2, Groups F, G T135°C; Ta −20 °C to +55 °C

safety.conditions: Protect from high-energy impacts and static; Ex-protective case correctly fitted; battery pack and SIM/SD only in ordinary areas; USB-C and POGO only in ordinary areas; charge −5 °C to +45 °C; USB-C Um 13.4 V, 3.2 A; Samsung headset EHS64AVFWE allowed (IECEx EPS 23.0079X).
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate: S Pen, Ex-protective case, belt clip BC T01, chest harness CH TPRO X2, leather case LC TPRO X2, stylus tether, carrying strap, Samsung headset EHS64AVFWE (audio jack).

specs.chip: Qualcomm Snapdragon SM7325-2-AB octa-core (4 x 2.4 + 4 x 1.8 GHz)
specs.touch: Can be operated while wearing gloves

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Among the lightest Zone 2 tablets of its size we list, at 930 g in use
limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T5 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 100 °C
